title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory is a proof-first, open-source software factory for turning specifications, behavior checks, design contracts, policy verification, Mermaid diagrams, and release receipts into auditable delivery through Unified Graph Ops. Version 0.39 adds a free LangGraph Assurance Bridge: teams record hash-only transitions in their own test harness, compare sealed reference and resumed lineages, and receive deterministic resume parity or a shareable first-divergence incident capsule. The release also adds a local read-only MCP tool and an opt-in GitHub proof-gate Action for recorded receipts. It never invokes a graph or replays side effects. Release media includes the current FactoryLine identity asset and real product captures.

Evidence boundary: the bridge does not establish production resilience, runtime correctness, external-system idempotency, or a complete transition capture. It does not expose raw state, prompts, or secrets; grant execution, repair, approval, merge, publication, deployment, signing, credential, connector, or external-message authority; or estimate time, token, cost, quality, or productivity savings. A passing receipt proves only the supplied sealed transitions and declared checks.
